content: Prompt-embedded nu one-liners must be shell-single-quoted: a nu -c "..." snippet inside an agent prompt loses every $-variable to bash double-quote interpolation (empty strings -> nu parse errors). Verified pattern (architect survey.md, run 01M2N36HV2C1T27FRHBS15Y3ZH): wrap the nu script in single quotes, use double-quoted nu strings inside, prefer fixed-position str substring over regex groups to avoid nested-quote escapes, and dry-run the exact fenced command extracted from the markdown before shipping the prompt.
